title: Immiscible proteins compete for RNA binding to order condensate layers.
authors: Snead, Wilton T; Skillicorn, Mary K; Shrinivas, Krishna; Gladfelter, Amy S
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合实验与物理模拟，揭示FUS/NONO等无序蛋白与TDP-43通过竞争性RNA结合及不相容性驱动paraspeckle凝聚体分层组织的机制，直接聚焦IDP介导的PPI与相分离机制建模，高度契合课题。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates mediate diverse and essential cellular functions by compartmentalizing biochemical pathways. Many condensates have internal subdomains with distinct compositional identities. A major challenge lies in dissecting the multicomponent logic that relates biomolecular features to emergent condensate organization. Nuclear paraspeckles are paradigmatic examples of multidomain condensates, comprising core and shell layers with distinct compositions that are scaffolded by the lncRNA NEAT1, which spans both layers. A prevailing model of paraspeckle assembly proposes that core proteins bind directly and specifically to core-associated NEAT1 domains. Combining informatics and biochemistry, we unexpectedly find that the essential core proteins FUS and NONO bind and condense preferentially with shell-associated NEAT1 domains. The shell protein TDP-43 exhibits similar NEAT1 domain preferences on its own but forms surfactant-like shell layers around core protein-driven condensates when both are present. Together, experiments and physics-based simulations suggest that competitive RNA binding and immiscibility between core and shell proteins order paraspeckle layers. More generally, we propose that subcondensate organization can spontaneously arise from a balance of collaborative and competitive protein binding to the same domains of a lncRNA.
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体通过区隔生化途径介导多种且必需的细胞功能。许多凝聚体具有组成身份不同的内部亚结构域。一个主要挑战在于解析将生物分子特征与涌现性凝聚体组织相关联的多组分逻辑。核散斑体是多结构域凝聚体的典型范例，包含组成不同的核心层和壳层，由跨越两层的lncRNA NEAT1作为支架。一种主流的散斑体组装模型提出，核心蛋白直接且特异性地结合核心相关NEAT1结构域。结合信息学和生物化学方法，我们意外发现必需核心蛋白FUS和NONO优先结合并凝聚壳相关NEAT1结构域。壳蛋白TDP-43单独存在时表现出类似的NEAT1结构域偏好，但当两者同时存在时，它会在核心蛋白驱动的凝聚体周围形成表面活性剂样壳层。综合实验和基于物理的模拟表明，核心蛋白与壳蛋白之间的竞争性RNA结合及不混溶性决定了散斑体层的排列。更广泛地，我们提出亚凝聚体组织可以自发产生于蛋白质对同一lncRNA结构域的协作性与竞争性结合之间的平衡。
